facts.fact: The Ministry of Innovation and Technology's 2023 e-government assessment, prepared with the Tony Blair Institute, refers to the approved Ethiopian eGovernment Interoperability Framework (EeGIF).
The assessment finds the E-Services Portal offers no data interoperability features, deviating from the approved EeGIF, and a standalone enterprise architecture not aligned with the national one.
